listing.name: Mario Kart Arcade GP — mka (sp00nznet)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The native entry starts the Namco and DolphinOS subsystems and opens a D3D11 window with a test triangle. The media-board boot sequence is still missing; the title screen, racing, audio and input remain unfinished. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Triforce USA GGPE01.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build from source on Windows with VS2022 and CMake using your own GGPE01 arcade ISO. Follow the project’s mka_launcher.exe ISO launch instructions. Media-board HLE replay and capture procedures are developer research, not complete player setup.

warnings: The native entry starts the Namco and DolphinOS subsystems and opens a D3D11 window with a test triangle. The media-board boot sequence is still missing; the title screen, racing, audio and input remain unfinished.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
